name: CXXC finger protein 5
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CXXC5 encodes CXXC-type zinc finger protein 5. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor binding and methyl-CpG binding. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Astroblastoma, MN1-altered; CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
